changes: Default preparation now converts to MP3 quickly and uses that MP3 for transcription.
The normal flow no longer creates a large transcription WAV before transcription.
Player MP3 generation avoids expensive audio filters.
Retry removes partial generated audio assets before reprocessing when the original exists.
known_risks: Transcription now reads the final MP3 rather than a temporary WAV in the normal flow.
Audio with severe noise should still be validated with real files after the speed change.
The stale job from the previous run may require retry or app restart.
